claims.claim: KONO's got a bit of a mixed bag going on right now. On one hand, life on the block seems pretty normal despite the lingering smell of smoke from the recent blaze. We've even got a newcomer from Jack London settling in, which is always nice to see. On the other hand, I've noticed that the neighborhood's vibe feels a bit off, and I'm not sure if it's just me being a fan of the A's and still feeling a little down about Mark Aitken leaving. I mean, he was a big part of Oakland, not just the team. As for the city's support, I'm not really sure what to say. I moved here from Chinatown a little while back because KONO felt like a better fit for me and my wife, but it's clear there's some tension around housing and retail vitality. I hope the city can figure out a way to balance things out.
